cold_chain_share_ppm.note: share of items that need the refrigerated range; stylised, not fitted (docs/use-cases.md section 3)

controlled_share_ppm.note: share of items with a per-order cap; stylised

critical_share_ppm.note: share of items whose absence costs more; stylised

refill_interval_days.note: [days, weight]; monthly or a 90-day supply; stylised

shelf_capacity_units.note: [units, weight]; a pharmacy's ambient shelf space; stylised

cold_capacity_units.note: [units, weight]; a pharmacy's refrigerated space; stylised

age_band_weights.note: weights of 18-39, 40-54, 55-64, 65-74, 75+ among patients on chronic medicines; stylised

copay_band_weights.note: weights of low, mid, high co-payment; stylised

therapeutic_group_weights.note: weights of chronic, respiratory, allergy items; stylised

season_amplitude_ppm.note: seasonal swing of weekly demand per group (chronic, respiratory, allergy): peak is 1+amp, trough 1-amp times the base; stylised

season_peak_week.note: week of the year (0 to 51) of each group's peak: respiratory in midwinter, allergy in spring; stylised

item_base_rate_milli.note: [units per week x 1000, weight] of an item at a pharmacy of scale 1; stylised

pharmacy_scale_ppm.note: [scale x 1e6, weight] of a pharmacy's demand against the base; stylised

order_cover_ppm.note: the pharmacy orders up to 1.5 times its recent weekly sales; a plain policy on purpose, so that stockouts and write-offs occur; stylised

trailing_weeks.note: weeks of the pharmacy's own sales (censored by stockouts) that its policy averages; stylised

lapse_base_ppm.note: chance, in parts per million, that a patient does not fill a refill (a lapse), before any other effect; stylised

lapse_per_extra_item_ppm.note: added to the chance for each chronic item beyond the first (a more complex regimen); stylised

lapse_copay_ppm.note: added to the chance for a low, mid or high co-payment; stylised

lapse_age_ppm.note: added to the chance for age bands 18-39, 40-54, 55-64, 65-74, 75+; stylised

lapse_stockout_ppm.note: THE COUPLING (docs/use-cases.md G3): added to the chance when the home pharmacy was out of the item in the window; stylised, and set to 0 for the control

stockout_window_weeks.note: weeks up to the due date in which a stockout counts as seen by the patient; stylised

delivery_prob_ppm.note: probability a pharmacy has a delivery on a day; stylised

window_start_hours.note: hour at which a delivery window opens (two hours long), weighted; stylised

stop_service_minutes.note: minutes at a stop (never less than the door-open minutes), weighted; stylised

door_open_minutes.note: minutes the doors are open at a stop, weighted; stylised

drive_wh_per_km.note: traction energy per km; stylised, of the order a medium electric van uses, not fitted

fridge_w.note: refrigeration unit electric power in watts at a mild outside temperature; stylised

fridge_temp_ppm.note: fraction by which refrigeration power rises per 10 degrees above 20 C; stylised

door_w.note: extra power in watts while the doors are open; stylised

noise_ppm.note: standard deviation of the multiplicative noise on a stop's energy, in ppm; stylised

excursion_base_ppm.note: base probability of a temperature excursion at a stop; stylised

excursion_per_door_min_ppm.note: added probability per minute the doors are open; stylised

excursion_per_10c_ppm.note: added probability per 10 degrees above 20 C outside; stylised

temp_mean_c.note: mean outside temperature in whole degrees; stylised

temp_noise_c.note: standard deviation of the daily noise in degrees; stylised

warm_peak_week.note: week of the year of the warmest days; stylised

grid_km.note: side of the square the pharmacies are placed in, depot at the corner; stylised

truck_battery_kwh.note: usable battery of a truck, weighted; stylised

reserve_kwh.note: energy a route must leave in the battery; stylised

depot_cap_kw.note: grid connection by hour of the night and day, in kW, shared with the refrigerated warehouse; stylised

depot_tariff_milli.note: price per kWh by hour in thousandths of a currency unit; stylised
